focus: Primary-source correction and actor expansion from Pass 261: Bank of Korea legislative chain, first Monetary Policy Board, Labor Standards Act metadata

verified_findings.claim: The Labor Standards Act No.286 was promulgated on 1953-05-10, not 1953-05-15.
evidence: National Archives Gazette No.890 dated 1953-05-10, record BA0185664 (archive title has an apparent typo 'Act No.28')
National Institute of Korean History 'Sources of Korean History' independently identifies Labor Standards Act No.286, Gazette No.890, 1953-05-10
National Law Information Center gives enactment 1953-05-10 and enforcement 1953-08-09
Ministry of Employment and Labor publication states enactment on 1953-05-10
verified_findings.correction_note: The Pass 261 conflict was caused by inconsistent secondary/compilation metadata plus an archive catalog typo. Preserve the typo as provenance metadata rather than propagating it as the statute number.

verified_findings.claim: The 1950-04-21 National Assembly did not merely rubber-stamp the government Bank of Korea bill; the Finance-Economy Committee amendment was adopted after debate.
evidence: NIHK contemporary-source compilation, dh_017_1950_04_21_0100, reports adoption of the Finance-Economy Committee amendment and identifies changes including Article 76 wording and exclusion of insurance/trust companies from eligible borrowers.
Bank of Korea official archive records plenary debate on 1950-04-18 and 04-21 and passage with 102 present, 78 yes, 6 no.
verified_findings.attribution_rule: Separate foreign expert drafting, Korean executive revision, committee amendment, and plenary adoption.

verified_findings.claim: The first Monetary Policy Board was a multi-actor institution and can seed additional independent politician/administrator nodes.
evidence: Bank of Korea 70-year history identifies regular members Choi Sun-ju, Gu Yong-seo, Jang Bong-ho, Ha Sang-yong, Lee Jeong-jae, Yun Posun and Hong Seong-ha; alternate members Kim Yu-taek, Heo Min-su, Yun Ho-byeong, Kim Gyo-cheol, Im Mun-hwan, Lee Jong-hyeon and Kim Do-yeon; Song In-sang and Jang Gi-yeong attended as staff/observers.
verified_findings.note: Membership does not itself prove authorship of individual policy decisions; meeting-by-meeting minutes remain required.
